decisions.reason: As a distant, niche maritime product with only limited visible follow-on commitment, its uncertainty has likely resolved enough that the option value no longer outweighs focusing resources on stronger core LED lines.
This product fits the firm's industrial lighting core and the added LED replacement kit signals positive learning and continued investment, so keeping it is the more attractive option.
Because this was a relaunch of a previously popular product close to the established offer, it looks more like a proven extension than a failed experiment and is worth retaining.
A pendant office luminaire is close to the firm's core business and likely inexpensive to carry in an expanding firm, so the option to keep selling it still has value.
Although the premium positioning makes it somewhat more vulnerable to portfolio pruning, it remains close to the firm's established professional lighting range and is still worth keeping for now.
